description:
No.39 Rathmore Village is located in the development of Tyrrelstown which is approx. 8 miles from Central Dublin, south of the old Hollystown Golf course, set between the Navan and the Ashbourne Road, and within 2 miles of the Blanchardstown Centre. The development is close to all amenities the Blanchardstown centre has to offer, and has the added benefit of being located within walking distance of the Tyrrelstown Town Centre which include retailers such as brand new Tesco store, Supervalu, Lidl, Paddy Power, Joanne Creighton Hair Group,  Hickeys Pharmacy and a variety of restaurants & Cafes.
 
_________________________________________________________________
No 39 Rathmore Village is a super 4 bed mid terrace three storey house presented in excellent condition throughout. 
Some of the special features afforded to this property are four double bedrooms, walk in condition, bright and airy, south facing low maintenance, rear garden, car parking for two cars & within minutes walking distance of the Tyrrelstown Town Centre.
It is the ideal family home, with its spacious bedrooms, and open plan living area.

The 40D bus provides a regular and convenient link to Dublin City Centre.


Viewing is highly advised.
